document_title: Video and Subtitle Settings - All Options Explained
description: What each video and subtitle setting does and what you see when you enable or disable them

fast_480p.file_size: Roughly 50-100 MB per hour of video
when_to_use: Testing to make sure everything looks right
fast_480p.quality_tradeoff: Visible compression, text may be harder to read

balanced_720p.file_size: Roughly 200-400 MB per hour of video
when_to_use: Good balance of quality and file size

high_1080p.file_size: Roughly 400-800 MB per hour of video
when_to_use: Final uploads where quality matters most
When viewers watch on large screens
high_1080p.quality_tradeoff: Best quality, but takes much longer

what_happens_when_enabled: The program transcribes your audio using AI (Whisper)
Word-by-word captions appear at the bottom of the video
Subtitle file (.srt) is also created separately
Subtitles are burned into the video
Viewers always see subtitles, cannot turn them off
Works on all platforms including social media
what_happens_when_disabled: Subtitles are in a separate .srt file
Viewers can toggle subtitles on/off on YouTube
Upload both video and .srt to YouTube

what_you_can_customize.outline: Black outline around text for visibility
what_you_can_customize.position: Bottom center, bottom left, top, etc.

preset_styles.modern: Bold white text with thick black outline (YouTube style)
preset_styles.classic: Simple white text with thin outline

word_level_subtitles.what_it_looks_like: Each word appears as it is spoken

chapter_level_subtitles.what_it_looks_like: Just shows chapter title at the start of each chapter
chapter_level_subtitles.used_when: Whisper is not installed or transcription is skipped

what_happens_when_enabled: Book title is displayed on the thumbnail
Text is styled to be readable and attractive
what_happens_when_disabled: Just the cover image, no text
Cleaner look if your cover already has text

custom_thumbnail.when_asked: After selecting an EPUB: 'Use extracted cover or select custom image?'
custom_thumbnail.option_1_extracted_cover: Uses the cover image from inside the EPUB file
custom_thumbnail.option_2_custom_image: You can select any image from your computer
what_you_see: 'Enter path to custom thumbnail image:' (or drag and drop)
Image is resized to match video resolution

what_happens_when_enabled: YouTube shows clickable chapters in the video progress bar
Viewers can jump directly to specific chapters
Each chapter is labeled with its title
what_happens_when_disabled: Video is just one continuous segment
chapter_markers.how_youtube_uses_them: YouTube automatically detects the chapter metadata and displays it

static_background.what_it_is: The cover image stays completely still for the entire video

zoom_effect.what_it_is: The cover image slowly zooms in during the video
zoom_effect.result: Adds subtle movement, feels more dynamic

pan_effect.what_it_is: The cover image slowly moves horizontally or vertically

what_it_does: Uses FFmpeg with complex filter graphs
Supports all effects, word-level subtitles, GPU acceleration

simple_renderer.when_used: Automatically falls back if advanced renderer fails
what_it_does: Uses MoviePy for basic video creation
Always works as long as Python runs

intro_text.what_it_is: The text that is spoken at the very start of each video
intro_text.default_example: Yo legends! Welcome back to the channel. Grab your headphones...

outro_text.what_it_is: The text spoken at the very end of each video
outro_text.default_example: Alright legends, that's it for today! If you're ready for the next chapter...

tagline.what_it_is: Your channel's catchphrase, added to YouTube description
